propositions: CLI reference syntax and options must derive deterministically from runtime parser artifacts and committed help bytes, proven by --check generators with byte-identity parity across Python versions
Hand-maintained command census (INTERCEPT_COMMANDS, regex ladder parsing) must be eliminated; all enumerable command syntax inputs must come from the registry
Overview, argparse, and exit-code tests must enumerate route classes directly from the registry via policy derivation rather than reconstructing command sets manually
A clean no-extras wheel must render every approved help form with exact committed bytes and no side effects from store, config, parser, or handler imports
Full-runtime-extra contract must resolve every lazy handler, parser, and selector reference and validate capability-to-extra mappings without executing command logic
Editorial examples and rationale must be structurally separate from generated syntax, registry-linted for spelling, and never override parser artifacts
